questions.stem: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the taxes payable under the Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA)?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Liability arises only when wages are actually, not constructively, paid to employees.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Credits for this tax are allowed to employers for certain state unemployment taxes paid by the employer.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The amount is withheld from the wages of all employees.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The amount is determined as a percentage of all compensation paid to an employee.

questions.explanation:
FUTA tax is imposed only on employers. Under IRC §3302, an employer receives a credit against the FUTA tax for contributions paid into a state unemployment fund (up to a maximum credit of 5.4% of FUTA wages), which is why the effective federal rate is usually much lower than the statutory rate.

FUTA liability arises on wages paid, which includes wages constructively paid, not only wages actually paid. FUTA is not withheld from employees' wages; the employer bears the entire tax. The tax applies only to the first $7,000 of wages paid to each employee during the year (IRC §3306(b)(1)), not to all compensation.
questions.explanationJa:
FUTA税は雇用主だけに課される。IRC §3302により、雇用主は州の失業保険基金への拠出額についてFUTA税から税額控除（FUTA課税賃金の5.4%が上限）を受けられ、実効税率は法定税率より大幅に低くなる。

FUTAの納税義務は賃金の支払で生じ、実際の支払だけでなく擬制的な支払（constructive payment）も含む。FUTAは従業員の賃金から源泉徴収されず、全額雇用主負担である。課税対象は各従業員の年間賃金のうち最初の$7,000だけで（IRC §3306(b)(1)）、報酬全額ではない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2015 Recently Released Q.25 (AICPA No. 90825)

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the Federal Unemployment Tax Act?

choices.label: A
choices.text: An employee, who resigns, regardless of cause, is eligible for unemployment benefits.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The federal unemployment system is funded by both employer and employee taxes.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The Act is intended to assist workers who are permanently out of work and need assistance in supporting themselves.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The unemployment insurance system is administered by the states through their employment laws.

questions.explanation:
The unemployment insurance system is a federal-state program. The Federal Unemployment Tax Act (IRC §§3301-3311) imposes a tax on employers, and employers receive a credit for contributions paid to approved state unemployment funds (IRC §3302). The states administer the program, setting eligibility and benefit rules under their own employment security laws.

An employee who resigns voluntarily without good cause generally is not eligible for benefits, so eligibility does not exist regardless of cause. FUTA tax is imposed only on employers, not employees. The system provides temporary assistance to workers who lose their jobs through no fault of their own, not support for those permanently out of work.
questions.explanationJa:
失業保険制度は連邦と州の共同制度である。連邦失業税法（FUTA、IRC §§3301-3311）は雇用主に課税し、雇用主は承認された州の失業基金への拠出額について税額控除を受ける（IRC §3302）。制度の運営は州が行い、給付要件や給付額は各州の雇用保障法で定められる。

正当な理由なく自己都合で退職した者は原則として給付を受けられないので、理由を問わず受給できるという文言は誤り。FUTA 税は雇用主のみに課され、従業員は負担しない。制度は自らの責任によらず職を失った労働者への一時的な支援が目的で、恒久的に職のない者の生活支援ではない。
questions.source: Proactive AICPA過去問DB REG 2020 Recently Released Part1 Q.8 (AICPA No. 58727)

questions.stem: Lee repairs high-speed looms for Sew Corp., a clothing manufacturer. Which of the following circumstances best indicates that Lee is an employee of Sew and not an independent contractor?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Lee's work is not supervised by Sew personnel.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Lee's tools are owned by Lee.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Lee is paid weekly by Sew.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Lee's work requires a high degree of technical skill.

questions.explanation: Whether a worker is an employee is determined under the common-law control test (IRC §3121(d)(2)), using factors such as the right to control how the work is done, method of payment, ownership of tools, and the skill required (Rev. Rul. 87-41). Regular payment by the hour, week, or month points to an employee relationship, whereas independent contractors are usually paid by the job. Lee being paid weekly by Sew is therefore the best indicator of employee status. Lee's work not being supervised by Sew personnel suggests that Sew lacks control over the details of the work, which points toward independent contractor status. Lee owning the tools indicates an investment by the worker, also a sign of an independent contractor. A high degree of technical skill is typical of independent specialists brought in for particular tasks and does not indicate employee status.
questions.explanationJa: 従業員か独立請負人かは、作業方法を支配する権利の有無を中心とするコモンロー上の支配基準で判断し、支払方法、道具の所有者、必要な技能などの要素を考慮します。時間・週・月単位で定期的に支払われるのは従業員の特徴で、独立請負人は通常、仕事ごとに支払われます。したがって「Sew から週払いで報酬を受けている」ことが従業員であることを最もよく示します。Sew の担当者が作業を監督していないことは、作業の細部を Sew が支配していないことを示し、独立請負人寄りの事実です。道具を Lee が所有していることも、働き手自身の投資を示すため独立請負人の特徴です。高度な専門技能が必要なことは、特定の作業のために外部から呼ばれる専門家に典型的で、従業員であることを示しません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Government Regulation Q.2

questions.stem: An employer who fails to withhold Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) taxes from covered employees' wages, but who pays both the employer and employee shares would

choices.label: A
choices.text: Be entitled to a refund from the IRS for the employees' share

choices.label: B
choices.text: Be allowed no federal tax deduction for any payments

choices.label: C
choices.text: Have a right to be reimbursed by the employees for the employees' share

choices.label: D
choices.text: Owe penalties and interest for failure to collect the tax

questions.explanation: The employee's share of FICA tax is imposed on the employee (IRC §3101), and the employer must collect it by withholding from wages (IRC §3102(a)). If the employer fails to withhold, the employer is liable for the tax (IRC §3102(b)), but the tax remains the employee's obligation, so an employer that pays the employee share may recover that amount from the employee, for example by deducting it from later wages (Treas. Reg. §31.3102-1). The employer is not entitled to a refund from the IRS for the employees' share, because that tax was actually owed and has simply been paid. Deductions are not denied for all payments: the employer's own share of FICA is deductible as a business expense. Because the employer has paid the full amount of tax due, there is no unpaid tax on which penalties and interest for failure to collect would be owed.
questions.explanationJa: FICA 税の従業員負担分は従業員に課される税で（IRC §3101）、雇用主は賃金から源泉徴収して納める義務を負います（§3102(a)）。源泉徴収を怠った場合、雇用主は税額について責任を負いますが（§3102(b)）、税の負担者はあくまで従業員なので、雇用主が従業員分を立て替えて納めた場合は、後の賃金から差し引くなどして従業員から回収できます。従業員分の税は実際に納めるべきものだったので、IRS から還付は受けられません。雇用主負担分の FICA は事業経費として控除できるため、「すべての支払いが控除できない」も誤りです。必要な税額は全額納付されているので、徴収漏れによる加算税や利子も生じません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Government Regulation Q.3

questions.stem: Taxes payable under the Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) are

choices.label: A
choices.text: Calculated as a fixed percentage of all compensation paid to an employee

choices.label: B
choices.text: Deductible by the employer as a business expense for federal income tax purposes

choices.label: C
choices.text: Payable by employers for all employees

choices.label: D
choices.text: Withheld from the wages of all covered employees

questions.explanation: FUTA tax is an excise tax imposed on employers (IRC §3301), and like other employer payroll taxes it is an ordinary and necessary business expense deductible for federal income tax purposes (IRC §162). FUTA is not calculated on all compensation paid to an employee, because it applies only to the first $7,000 of wages paid to each employee during the year (IRC §3306(b)(1)). FUTA is not payable by employers for all employees; it applies only to employers that meet the statutory wage or employment tests and only to covered employment, and certain services are excluded (IRC §3306(a), (c)). FUTA is not withheld from employees' wages, because the tax is borne solely by the employer.
questions.explanationJa: FUTA 税は雇用主に課される税で（IRC §3301）、他の雇用主負担の給与税と同じく、連邦所得税の計算上、通常かつ必要な事業経費として控除できます。課税対象は各従業員の年間賃金のうち最初の7,000ドルまでなので、「支払った報酬全額に一定率を掛ける」は誤りです。また、法定の賃金額・雇用期間の基準を満たす雇用主の対象雇用に限って課され、適用除外の役務もあるため、「すべての従業員について支払う」も誤りです。FUTA 税は雇用主だけが負担するもので、従業員の賃金から源泉徴収されることはありません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Government Regulation Q.5
